scope: All ten full-frame contact-sheet views, annotation-overlay presentation and retained demonstration background
engineering_observations: All ten full-frame tiles have readable captions. Gold direct amodal rectangles appear only on positives.

At 0.5 and 1 cm/px a distinct dark tapered silhouette is inside each rectangle, with tail/flukes upper-left and nose lower-right. A smaller silhouette remains distinguishable at 2 cm/px; small dark marks remain distinguishable at 3–4 cm/px, with limited anatomical detail.
The boxed target does not overlap the bottom-edge background animal at 3 or 4 cm/px. Its corresponding form and overlays are absent in negatives.
The 0.5, 1 and 2 cm/px negatives look essentially uniform blue water. At 3 and 4 cm/px unlabelled flukes/body enter from the bottom at corresponding paired locations.
Bottom-edge background shading/detail differs subtly between rows, especially around the flukes at 3 cm/px. Its cause is not established; pixel equivalence or a USD state mutation is not inferred.

Descent/rootdepth1.9m are actual retained-state metadata on a static mesh proxy. This view does not certify biological pose/animation, water optics or exact visible/refracted outlines; machine visibility stays unknown.
